card.name: Linking words before place and group names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is", "of", and "the" in encyclopedic geography or history text, right before a proper name like a place, people, or institution.

modes.label: "the" before a name in a list
modes.description: The word "the" in a list of places, groups, or institutions, just before the next proper name.

modes.label: Link word before a name or term
modes.description: "is" or "of" in a geography or history sentence that leads into a name or local term.
